grpo_ablations.note: tabular stand-in for the GRPO against PPO comparison; no critic is trained

rows.variant: REINFORCE with group baseline (1 epoch, no clip, no KL)

grpo_beta_budget.cost_unit: sampled actions per iteration = 8 prompts x group size 8 = 64

misaligned_forgetting.rule: on the first k prompts the chosen action is correct plus 1 and the rejected action is the correct one

note: Synthetic NumPy teaching models only, rerun across seeds and settings. No real LLM, no real text data, no GPU run.

seeds.seed_rule: seed offset s adds 1000 * s to every seed of the run; s = 0 is the recorded configuration

sft_baselines.note: same splits and minibatch schedule; LoRA keeps alpha 4 so scaling is 4 / rank; the target change is rank 2 by construction

site_fixtures.note: Build init_policy (seed 21) logits, so the site's DPO port starts from the recorded policy
